evidence.quote: Criterion-12 closure (PNC-019, lanes C12-DC1 for the twelve `collaboration.*` families and C12-DC2 for the BrainStorm and Review families) keeps every guard table and row and adds per-clause evidence for the whole-definition schema rows. Each schema occurrence (PS01 payload, SO03 prepared source, WR01 application wrapper, EV01 EventRecord, CK01 projection checkpoint) stays one row that validates the complete closed definition. `python3 scripts/pm-dc-c12-check.py clauses --out <dir>` inventories, per family and boundary, every keyword clause that row's validator evaluates, following `$ref`, with the clause's literal schema location; builds witnesses from the checker's own valid probes in which the row reports exactly one error (one value changed, or one member replaced by a value valid at its own schema node, another control's or generated, or an enclosing object set so an `if` branch applies); requires each witness's first refusal in the complete checker to be that schema row; then removes each clause in place from the schema the checker reads, reruns its witnesses and the family's controls through the complete checker, and restores it. Only disappearance of the exact expected refusal is a kill. A cut that raises is INVALID, and one that only a control detects is recorded apart. A clause no witness can isolate needs a written mechanical proof: an implying pattern, enum or const, the definition or edition the route selects, or an `if` branch a const fixes. `joins` lists, for every equality join row, a single-copy witness for each copy, from the gated collection and a lexical-class mutation search over each family's valid probes. `retained` snapshots the sealed custody store around every historical and checkpoint read and adds the missing, ambiguous and other-original receipt negatives. `datetime` runs the shared timestamp battery, with a calendar supplement, at every family timestamp field through the complete checker, with expectations composed from the owner pattern and the shared `date_time` profile.
